dyedBillVerification.verification: Selected eligible employee password on every create/edit save; exact-command, 90-second, single-use proof

production.movementVerification: Selected eligible employee password; exact-command, single-use proof; operator may select themselves
production.uiStatus: Existing Production source remains frozen pending the separate UI implementation
production.pendingMovement: Authorized portal actor; active employee selection without extra password; any later stage; complete atomic variant/size outputs; expected transition ID guards a single handover per visit; immutable output snapshot

productionStudio.persistence: Namespaced browser storage only; no Supabase imports or business writes
productionStudio.hierarchy: Production per item part; expandable read-only job attempt history, not arbitrary child tasks
productionStudio.stageMovement: Mock stage selection and stage drops open the shared handover form; every variant/size and selected employee required; one handover per job visit; no live writes
productionStudio.deployment: Standalone entry excluded when DEPLOY_BUILD=1; shared components used by portal preview

productionTaskBoard.ownership: Item checklist shared by item_id; task per item_part_id; original jobs and challans retained; variants/sizes selected from linked item records
productionTaskBoard.movement: Complete every variant/size output and select existing employee once per current job visit; unequal totals allowed; direct stage selection routes through handover
productionTaskBoard.liveWrites: Local adapter never handles live writes; live mode uses liveProductionWorkspace commands.
productionTaskBoard.preferences: Named saved views removed from the portal MVP; transient layout controls remain browser-local
productionTaskBoard.plannedPieces: Read-only sum of item_cut_ratio.pieces across the item sizes, refreshed from item setup
productionTaskBoard.history: productionJobs is read-only Job history; original job IDs, piece records and challan links preserved
productionTaskBoard.start: Task Board create permission starts an existing prepared item part once at the first stage; local job code clearly marked LOCAL; live codes remain database-generated

itemBatchNumber.meaning: Optional manually entered reference; no uniqueness or generation rule

productionReferences.ownership: Each page edits only its reference row; linked Production/Employee records are not edited
productionReferences.liveWrites: Local reference adapter stays separate; live mode uses the reviewed production setup contract.

liveProductionWorkspace.itemOwnership: Item owns parts, size allocations, variant links and checklist. Shared variant metadata is selected and edited only in Variants. Attachments are read through private Files, not edited by setup command.
liveProductionWorkspace.concurrency: Expected source job and transition for movement; production-document revision for task edits; expected item checklist and setup row snapshots; all writes transactional.
liveProductionWorkspace.unsupportedFields: Priority unavailable; progress derived from configured stage position. No named saved views.
liveProductionWorkspace.floor: Signed-in portal session and Production permissions required. No anonymous QR endpoint.
liveProductionWorkspace.release: Migration and portal release through reviewed main Actions workflows; no direct live SQL.
liveProductionWorkspace.imageAccess: Existing private Files read path; Production viewers can read itemImage only for items linked to Production. No upload permission added.
